body:
lina: FYI launching a small Dedicated pool for RTX-7000 in ca-central-1 (Toronto). Purpose: high-memory multimodal inference and large-batch experiments. Rolling out to Vela plan customers first, pilot capacity only.

gareth: What's the initial node count and billing tag?

lina: pool_id=pool-rtx7000-yyz-01, nodes=10, billing tag `dedicated:rtx7000.ca-central-1`. Treat like a100x for quota families.

deploy-bot: [automation] provision_start pool=pool-rtx7000-yyz-01 owner=@lina expected_nodes=10

ops: Ops notes: single AZ deployment. Burst policy: +4 nodes for 10m bursts when enabled per-customer. Fallback: route to rtx8000 pools in us-east-1 on overload. Watch temp and power headroom.

pricing: Pricing: internal tier = rtx7000_pilot (15% premium vs rtx8000 due to memory profile). Will share formal pricing doc in 30m.

gareth: Any runtime flags to be aware of? Kernels validated for fp16 and bf16; 4-bit quant is supported behind `runtime.beta.rtx7000_4bit=true`.

lina: SRE checklist:
1) monitor rtx7000-util and rtx7000-thermals
2) if queue latency > 300ms for 5m, enable fallback to us-east-1
3) if thermal throttling > 60% for 2m, trigger scale-down and alert infra

deploy-bot: [automation] provision_complete pool=pool-rtx7000-yyz-01 state=active nodes=10

lina: Pilot is live. Action items: pricing to publish doc (ETA 30m), sales to tag pilot customers (ETA 2h), infra to verify billing tag on invoices (ETA 1h). Closing thread after confirmations.
